newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index ends session 0.22 pct higher.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index ends session 0.22 pct higher.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed up by 0.22 percent in active trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 504.04 points from 502.94 on Tuesday.

Total volume was 6.61 million dinars against 6.75 million. Over-the-counter exchanges amounted to 3.96 million dinars from 4.25 million dinars over the previous session. Turnover on the first market was 2.52 million dinars with 75,811 shares changing hands.
Banque Nationale Agricole won 2.04 dinars to 32.6 dinars with 60,375 shares changing hands.
Detergents firm gained 0.86 dinar to 37. BTEI was up 0.4 dinar to 23.4 dinars. Amen Bank advanced 0.3 dinar to 36.5. Placement de Tunisie rose 0.3 dinar to 13.7 dinars. UBCI was up 0.2 dinar to 52.5.
Leasing firm Tunisie Leasing fell 0.8 dinar to 32.2 dinars. Palm Beach Hotels slid 0.3 dinar to 11. BIAT was down 0.28 dinar to 37 dinars.
